# MASA source fixture

`masa-observation-source.json` is an unchanged copy of MASA 0.2.0's
`examples/0.2.0/valid/mapping.masa.json`, from local repository HEAD
`a967339d77cb7adfb977061e6f3299ff27e55619`.

The stale solar-index field is synthetic conformance data. No feed was queried,
and this fixture is not a physical measurement. The adapter uses a host-supplied
MASA validator; it does not copy MASA's schema definitions.
